'''Randon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from which the [[Randoni]] originated. It was a large business world with crowded bazaars and elegant corporate towers. It was at the intersection with several major trade routes, including the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]], [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']], [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']], and the [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

The world was overrun by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] shortly after they arrived in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].
